name: neo4j
description: Neo4j graph starter — schema, read-only Cypher and semantic search tools, with an interactive Bloom-like graph visualization. Runs against a local database or Neo4j Aura.

extraScripts.test:agent: cd agent && uv run --group dev pytest

envVars.name: NEO4J_URI
envVars.description: Bolt URI of the graph database. bolt://localhost:7687 for the bundled Docker database, or neo4j+s://<instance-id>.databases.neo4j.io for Neo4j Aura.

envVars.name: NEO4J_DATABASE
envVars.description: Database name within the instance. Defaults to neo4j.

envVars.name: NEO4J_ALLOW_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to true to register the write tool. Off by default — with it unset the agent has no way to modify the graph, and there is no human-approval step in front of writes.

envVars.name: NEO4J_VECTOR_INDEX
envVars.description: Vector index name. Set together with FOUNDRY_EMBEDDING_MODEL to register the semantic-search tool.

envVars.name: FOUNDRY_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Embedding model deployment used for semantic graph search.

envVars.name: FOUNDRY_MODELS_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Foundry inference endpoint for the embedding model, for example https://<project>.services.ai.azure.com/models.
